sections.evidence: Black bricks spread across x=2–12 at y=3 between the wheel positions. Light gray strips occupy the front and rear ends at z=0 and z=23.

sections.label: Truck body and cargo bed
sections.evidence: Broad red courses form the hood and lower cab at z=1–15. Dark gray flooring and narrow red sidewalls define the cargo bed at z=15–23; initial blue cab pieces appear above.

sections.label: Cab windows and roof
sections.evidence: Blue bricks fill the cab window region at z=8–14, y=8–9. Red framing borders the windows, and red bricks at y=10 form the roof across x=2–12.

sections.label: Front bumper and headlight
sections.evidence: Light gray #46 and #92 occupy x=10–12 at z=0 on y=3–4. White #131 sits directly above them at y=5, forming a front corner headlight.
